summary: Verified BOTH web and mobile scroll-to-top-on-submit + CSC sticky progress bar fixes. On web: CSC (top=73), CE (top=0), BC (top=72), PC (top=72) all scroll the result container to just below the sticky h-16 header after submit. CSC sticky progress bar (data-testid csc-progress-sticky) stays pinned at top=64 while scrolling through the quiz (verified visually via screenshot showing '0 of 16 answered 0%' at top with questions 6-9 visible below). On mobile Expo web preview: CSC sticky testID csc-progress-sticky stays anchored at top=92 (outside ScrollView) both before and after scrolling the inner ScrollView; BC result lands at top=104 and PC result at top=76 after submit — both correctly at the top of the viewport just below the header. Reviewed code for all listed tools: web hook useScrollToResult + resultRef + scroll-mt-20 wired in PriceCheckerTool, BudgetCalculatorTool, InvoiceCheckerTool, StatementDecoderTool, CarePlanReviewer (both resultRef + fileResultRef), CarerSelfAssessment, CscStreamMixIat, ProviderComparison, ChspTools, ClassificationCheck. ContributionEstimator uses its own document.getElementById('ce-result').scrollIntoView (still works — top=0 verified) but does NOT apply scroll-mt-20 so the result overshoots by ~64px behind the sticky header on web (still functionally correct, just visually flush with top of viewport instead of below the header). Mobile hook useScrollToResult wired in all 6 tool components with onLayout+scrollToResult.

issues: ce-result section is missing scroll-mt-20 (uses inline scrollIntoView instead of the shared useScrollToResult hook). After submit, ce-result lands at top=0 (flush with viewport top) rather than top~=72 below the sticky h-16 header. Result is still visible but not offset below the header. Low priority polish — consider migrating ContributionEstimator to useScrollToResult for consistency.

action_items: (Optional polish) In /app/frontend/src/pages/tools/ContributionEstimator.jsx swap the manual document.getElementById('ce-result').scrollIntoView for the shared useScrollToResult hook and add className='scroll-mt-20' to the ce-result section so the result sits below the sticky h-16 header (currently lands at top=0). Everything else already uses the shared hook + scroll-mt-20.
critical_code_review_comments: CSC web sticky bar (sticky top-16) works only while its parent container is still on-screen (verified via mid-scroll top=64). At bottom of quiz the parent runs out and the bar unsticks — acceptable because the user won't scroll below the quiz until submit.
Mobile CSC sticky bar sits OUTSIDE the ScrollView (correct per requirement) — verified top position unchanged after scrolling inner ScrollView by 1000px.
CarePlanReviewer has two independent scroll refs (resultRef, fileResultRef) — good separation for the two result modes.

success_rate.frontend: web 95% (5/5 verified deterministic tools PASS; ce-result missing scroll-mt-20 offset), mobile 100% (3/3 verified: CSC sticky + BC/PC scroll-to-top)

rca of the issue: Original bug: submit did not move results to top and CSC progress bar scrolled out of view. Fix (verified): (a) useScrollToResult hook scrolls the result container into view via scrollIntoView(behavior:smooth, block:start) with a 2xrAF delay so the conditionally-mounted result has laid out; result containers add scroll-mt-20 to compensate for the sticky h-16 header. (b) CSC progress bar wrapped in a `sticky top-16 z-30` div (web) and moved OUTSIDE the ScrollView (mobile) so it remains visible during quiz answering. Mobile hook uses onLayout to measure the result offset then scrollRef.current.scrollTo({y: measuredY-12}). Both surfaces verified working.
